minor.issue: FIXED: doc dict was mutated by motor's insert_one (added _id ObjectId), then passed to _hydrate_posts and returned — caused 500 'ObjectId is not iterable / vars() missing __dict__' on JSON serialization. Applied fix: doc.pop('_id', None) right after insert_one.

Minor reporting bug: `coupons_created` counter over-counts on idempotent re-runs. `_create_coupon_for_provider` returns the existing doc (correct, DB-idempotent), but the caller does `if doc: created += 1` so every idempotent run reports `coupons_created>=1` even when no new coupon was inserted. DB state remains idempotent (no duplicates). Recommend: make _create_coupon_for_provider return None when existing, or add a created flag.

integration_issues.issue: Page fires /community/posts/feed, /community/suggested, /community/me/follows on mount when there's no session, producing 401s in browser console (silently caught). Guard these fetches with `if (user)` to keep DevTools clean.

critical_code_review_comments: ROOT CAUSE of 500 on create-post: motor's `insert_one(doc)` injects `_id: ObjectId(...)` into the caller's dict in place. The endpoint then passed this same `doc` to `_hydrate_posts` and returned it. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder choked on the ObjectId. Pattern to avoid project-wide: always `doc.pop('_id', None)` after any insert when you reuse the dict in a response. Applied fix on line ~4110 of server.py.

Scheduler tests confirmed: SCHEDULER_TICK_SECONDS=1800, _scheduler_task started at startup, force-run endpoint bypasses time guard correctly, scheduler_state.upsert tracks last_run_at + last_result + forced flag, audit_log fires for force-run.

_hydrate_posts correctly attaches author{name,picture,role,slug,business_name,city,state,is_provider} + liked_by_me + author.followed_by_me. Tested both anon (everything false/null where applicable) and authenticated (flags accurate).

Rate-limit `5 posts per 10 minutes` works as advertised (test_create + test_like exhaust the client quota fast — required test refactor to use provider session for owner-delete to keep client quota for create+like). The rate-limit counter does NOT filter is_hidden, so soft-deleted posts still count against quota (acceptable design but worth documenting).
Delete endpoint is properly ACL'd: owner OR admin can delete, others get 403, unknown post → 404. Soft-delete sets is_hidden=true; list_posts filter `{is_hidden: {$ne: true}}` correctly hides them.
Follow endpoints are idempotent (POST twice = still following:true, DELETE twice = still following:false). Self-follow blocked with Spanish message. Unknown provider 404.

Trending endpoint uses last-7d window with $lookup to provider_profiles (so requires María's recent post → category Limpieza shows up). Falls back to top-active categories when no signal — verified by test.

rca_of_the_issue: Initial 5 test failures all rooted in a single bug: POST /api/community/posts returned 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId leaking into the response. Root cause: `await db.community_posts.insert_one(doc)` mutates the original dict in place — motor adds `_id: ObjectId(...)`. The endpoint then passed the same `doc` to `_hydrate_posts([doc], ...)` and returned the hydrated copy that still carried the `_id`. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder threw 'ObjectId is not iterable / vars() argument must have __dict__'. Cascading failures: test_create_success, test_like (depends on create), test_delete_others_post (depends on provider create), test_owner_can_delete (depends on create). FIX: added `doc.pop('_id', None)` immediately after insert_one — single-line change, verified by 26/26 green run + iter40 regression 20/20 green. Secondary minor finding: `coupons_created` over-counts on idempotent monthly-snapshot re-runs (reporting only, DB stays idempotent).
